experiments.title: Measure Pi process/startup contribution
experiments.objective: Quantify Pi startup_ms as a fraction of successful mock RPC wall time across repeated runs. Determine whether persistent Pi deserves round-2 work.

experiments.title: Measure first-model-text latency
experiments.objective: Measure first_model_text_ms and its variance relative to rpc_ms. Identify whether model wait dominates runtime.

experiments.title: Measure prompt payload size
experiments.objective: Measure prompt_bytes for representative investigate and visual-story mock flows. Identify the largest prompt construction contributors.

experiments.title: Measure tool surface by profile
experiments.objective: Inventory investigate/publication/visual/visual-story/full tool counts and estimate registration surface per profile from runtime definitions.

experiments.title: Quantify phase-scoping opportunity
experiments.objective: Using tool_phase_policy and tool definitions, calculate how many tools each phase would expose for visual-story and investigate profiles.

experiments.title: Measure tool schema bytes
experiments.objective: Instrument only through temporary analysis scripts to estimate serialized tool schema bytes per profile and phase; do not edit repo source.

experiments.title: Measure artifact context sizes
experiments.objective: Measure bytes of major IR artifacts, manifests, claims, plans, and conversation inputs in representative fixtures to estimate Stage Packet savings.

experiments.title: Derive minimal Stage Packet fields
experiments.objective: From existing IR consumers, identify minimal refs/hashes/reason codes needed between research, design, and publish boundaries; report estimated byte reduction.

experiments.title: Measure completion retry path
experiments.objective: Use existing completion tests/mocks to quantify bounded completion retry extra RPC count and wall-time contribution.

experiments.title: Map deterministic validator costs
experiments.objective: Measure runtime of major local validators/tests and classify mechanical, bounded-presentation, semantic.

experiments.title: Find deterministic repair candidates
experiments.objective: Audit validator failure modes and list repairs safe for deterministic runtime under AutoRepair ∩ {Fact, Claim, SQL, Evidence} = empty.

experiments.title: Measure local DAG speedup
experiments.objective: Use newsroom_parallel_tasks smoke/perf paths to measure sequential vs supported concurrency for read-only local evidence tasks.

experiments.title: Build E2E critical-path map
experiments.objective: From code and mock timings, map investigate control path and identify serial sections that Amdahl limits.

experiments.title: Count Pi process launches
experiments.objective: Trace Rust run_prompt call sites and representative mock flows to estimate how many Pi processes launch per investigation and continuation.

experiments.title: Measure continuation overhead
experiments.objective: Compare mock initial vs continue_session flows for startup/rpc/prompt metrics and identify persistence benefit ceiling.

experiments.title: Audit metric aggregation semantics
experiments.objective: Determine where pi_rpc aggregation is cumulative vs operation-local and whether this would bias A/B experiments.

experiments.title: Audit failed-RPC observability
experiments.objective: Identify metrics lost on unsuccessful Pi RPC sessions and propose minimal round-2 event fields without implementation.

experiments.title: Audit tool_count semantics
experiments.objective: Check NEWSROOM_PHASE/profile interactions and identify when current tool_count overstates effective registered tools.

experiments.title: Audit prompt control logic
experiments.objective: Inspect src/prompt.rs sequencing instructions and classify which deterministic decisions could move to a sparse supervisor without semantic loss.

experiments.title: Propose macro checkpoints
experiments.objective: Map existing investigate phases and completion gates into the smallest useful RESEARCH/DESIGN/PUBLISH checkpoints; define measurable success criteria.
